text.unlock: 糧倉、部落關係的選擇結果
text.unlockEn: Food store, village ties (depends on your choice)

steps.text: 到椰油的雜貨店，聽老闆說泡麵
steps.textEn: Go to the Yayo grocery store and hear the owner talk about instant noodles

lines.zh: 泡麵最好賣了。方便、放得久，船一來就補貨。
lines.en: Instant noodles sell best. Handy, they keep for ages, and we restock whenever the boat comes.

lines.zh: 可是風浪大、船停開的時候，架子一下就空了。
lines.en: But when the sea is rough and the boats stop, the shelves empty fast.

steps.text: 回家問女性長輩怎麼看
steps.textEn: Go home and ask the woman elder what she thinks

lines.zh: 忙的時候吃泡麵，大家都吃過，不是壞事。
lines.en: We all eat instant noodles when we're busy. It's not a bad thing.

lines.zh: 可是芋頭和魚，要有人種、有人捕，才不會斷掉。你們自己想想。
lines.en: But taro and fish need people to grow and catch them, or it all stops. Think about it yourselves.

toast: 泡麵和田裡的芋頭，都在現在的餐桌上。
toastEn: Instant noodles and taro from the fields are both on today's table.

hint.zh: 椰油的雜貨店老闆說，泡麵是店裡賣最好的東西。
hint.en: The Yayo grocery store owner says instant noodles are the best seller in the shop.

text.coop: 選「接手耕作」要雙人：族男＋族女
text.coopEn: Choosing "Take over the field" needs a pair: Tao man + Tao woman

steps.text: 野銀的水芋田長輩說起一塊荒掉的田
steps.textEn: The Ivalino taro field elder talks about a field gone wild

lines.zh: 這塊田的主人去台灣工作了，好幾年沒人照顧，草比人還高。
lines.en: The owner of this field went to work in Taiwan. No one has looked after it for years — the weeds are taller than people.

lines.zh: 你們兩個要不要試試看接手？我會先問過田主人家。
lines.en: Do you two want to try taking it over? I'll ask the owner's family first.

steps.text: 族男清掉田埂上的雜草，族女把水路通開
steps.textEn: The Tao man clears the weeds from the field banks, and the Tao woman opens the water channel

lines.zh: 草根好深，一點一點拔。
lines.en: The roots go so deep. Pull them out bit by bit.

lines.zh: 水路通了！水又流進田裡了。
lines.en: The channel is open! Water is flowing into the field again.

steps.textEn: Report to the taro field elder

lines.zh: 田要有人走進去，才不會荒掉。明年就可以種了。
lines.en: A field needs people walking in it, or it goes wild. Next year you can plant.

toast: 明年可以在這塊田重新種下水芋。
toastEn: Next year you can plant taro in this field again.

hint.zh: 野銀的水芋田長輩說，有一塊田荒了好幾年。
hint.en: The Ivalino taro field elder says one field has been abandoned for years.

quests.labourNote: 整地、引水本來是族男的工作（R1），廢耕田的接手由族男、族女一起做
review: 廢耕水芋田的接手是否需要田主人家同意、由誰來談，請族人確認

text.coop: 雙人：族人＋旅人，從兩邊看同一件事
text.coopEn: Pair: Tao member + Traveller, seeing the same thing from two sides

steps.text: 東清的族人說起暑假的觀光旺季
steps.textEn: An Iranmeylek villager talks about the summer tourist season

lines.zh: 暑假的東清，晚上夜市好熱鬧，機車停滿路邊。
lines.en: In summer, Iranmeylek's night market is so lively, and scooters line the roadside.

lines.zh: 遊客多，部落的收入多一點；可是灘頭、家門口，也常有人亂走、亂拍。
lines.en: More tourists means a bit more income for the village. But people also wander and take photos all over the beach and outside our homes.

steps.text: 族人和旅人一起站在東清灣，看同一片海灘
steps.textEn: The Tao member and the traveller stand together at Dongqing Bay, looking at the same beach

lines.zh: 對我們來說，這裡是出海的地方，也是家門口。
lines.en: For us, this is where we go to sea — and it's our front door.

lines.zh: 對遊客來說，這裡是假期。我是客人，好玩也要記得這裡是別人的家。
lines.en: For tourists, it's a holiday. I'm a guest. Having fun is fine, but I should remember this is someone's home.

steps.text: 旅人提醒想坐上拼板舟拍照的情侶遊客
steps.textEn: The traveller has a word with a couple who want to sit in a plank boat for a photo

lines.zh: 不好意思，拼板舟是族人的，不能坐上去拍。在路邊拍海就很漂亮。
lines.en: Excuse me, the plank boats belong to Tao families. You can't sit in them for photos. The sea looks lovely from the roadside.

lines.zh: 啊，我們不知道。謝謝你告訴我們！
lines.en: Oh, we didn't know. Thanks for telling us!

toast: 從兩邊看同一件事：觀光旺季。
toastEn: The same thing from two sides: tourist high season.

hint.zh: 暑假的東清好熱鬧，東清的族人好像有話想說。
hint.en: Iranmeylek is so busy in summer. An Iranmeylek villager seems to have something to say.

review: 觀光旺季對部落的影響（收入與打擾並存）的說法請族人確認

steps.text: 雜貨店老闆說起店裡的東西從哪裡來
steps.textEn: The grocery store owner talks about where the shop's goods come from

lines.zh: 米、麵、罐頭、飲料，都是船從台灣載來的。
lines.en: Rice, noodles, cans, drinks — the boat brings them all from Taiwan.

lines.zh: 風浪一大，船停開，架子就空了。
lines.en: When the sea gets rough and the boats stop, the shelves go empty.

steps.textEn: Go home and listen to the woman elder

lines.zh: 以前島上吃的，都是島上長的。現在不一樣了，有方便，也有擔心。
lines.en: We used to eat only what grew on the island. Now it's different — it's handy, but there are worries too.

lines.zh: 這一段的觀點，還要請族人提供。
lines.en: The view in this part still needs to come from the community.

toast: 店裡的東西大多坐船來。
toastEn: Most of the shop's goods come by boat.

hint.zh: 雜貨店的貨，好像要看船有沒有來。
hint.en: What the grocery store has seems to depend on whether the boat came in.

review: 進口食材的觀點待族人提供；目前只呈現運補與存糧的事實

name.zh: 族人認為最重要的現代挑戰
name.en: The modern challenge the Tao people see as most important

steps.text: 問部落文化工作者：族人覺得最重要的現代挑戰是什麼
steps.textEn: Ask the village culture worker: what do the Tao people see as the biggest modern challenge?

lines.zh: 最重要的挑戰？每個人的答案都不一樣。
lines.en: The biggest challenge? Everyone will give a different answer.

lines.zh: 你們去問問看，不要只聽一個人的。
lines.en: Go and ask around. Don't just listen to one person.

lines.zh: 年輕人去台灣工作，部落裡常常只剩老人和小孩。
lines.en: Young people go to Taiwan for work. Often only the old and the kids are left in the village.

lines.zh: 孩子會說族語的越來越少。語言沒了，很多故事也跟著沒了。
lines.en: Fewer and fewer kids speak Tao. When a language goes, many stories go with it.

lines.zh: 海裡的東西，好像沒有以前多了。
lines.en: There doesn't seem to be as much in the sea as there used to be.

steps.text: 回去告訴部落文化工作者
steps.textEn: Go back and tell the village culture worker

lines.zh: 你們聽到的，都是真的，也都只是一部分。
lines.en: Everything you heard is true — and each is only one part.

lines.zh: 這一頁，要留給族人自己來寫。
lines.en: This page is left for the Tao people to write themselves.

toast: 這一頁留給族人自己來寫。
toastEn: This page is left for the Tao people to write themselves.

hint.zh: 部落文化工作者說，現代的挑戰要多聽幾個人說。
hint.en: The village culture worker says to hear from several people about modern challenges.

review: 「族人認為最重要的現代挑戰」必須由族人提供；目前三種說法只是常聽到的個人看法（人口外移、族語、漁獲），請族人改寫或替換

text.unlock: 改稱 Syaman-、Sinan-，解鎖「教導孩子辨認魚類」
text.unlockEn: Become Syaman- / Sinan-, unlocks "Teach a child to tell fish apart"

steps.text: 在涼亭上，聽長輩說島上的名字
steps.textEn: On the pavilion, listen to the elder talk about names on the island

lines.zh: 在島上，有了第一個孩子，大人的名字就跟著孩子改。
lines.en: On the island, when someone has their first child, the parents' names change with the child.

lines.zh: 爸爸叫 Syaman，媽媽叫 Sinan，後面接孩子的名字。
lines.en: The father becomes Syaman and the mother Sinan, followed by the child's name.

lines.zh: 等你們有一天有了孩子，大家就會用孩子的名字叫你們。名字，是跟著家一起長大的。
lines.en: One day when you have children, everyone will call you by your child's name. Names grow along with the family.

lines.zh: 那時候，我們再帶孩子回來，教他認魚。
lines.en: Then we'll bring the child back and teach them about fish.

toast: 解鎖「教導孩子辨認魚類」。
toastEn: Unlocked "Teach a child to tell fish apart".

hint.zh: 一年過去了，主人家的長輩在涼亭上，好像想說說名字的事。
hint.en: A year has passed. The host family's elder on the pavilion seems to want to talk about names.

review: 親從子名（Syaman-、Sinan-）的說明方式請族人確認；遊戲不會真的改隊員的名字

name.zh: 衛生所醫師的安全下水與工作提醒
name.en: The health station doctor's tips on safe swimming and work

text.unlock: 急救卡、受傷後恢復較快
text.unlockEn: First aid card, faster recovery after injury

steps.text: 聽衛生所醫師說安全下水與工作的提醒
steps.textEn: Hear the health station doctor's tips on safe swimming and work

lines.zh: 下水前先看浪、看天氣，不要一個人下水。
lines.en: Check the waves and weather before going in. Never go in alone.

lines.zh: 救生衣穿好，扣子扣緊。礁岩很利，穿防滑鞋。
lines.en: Put on your life jacket and do up the buckles. The reef rocks are sharp — wear non-slip shoes.

lines.zh: 曬魚、搬木頭的時候多喝水，中午最熱的時候休息一下。
lines.en: Drink plenty of water when drying fish or carrying wood, and rest at midday when it's hottest.

toastEn: You noted the doctor's safety tips.

hint.zh: 衛生所醫師說，下水和工作之前有幾件事要注意。
hint.en: The health station doctor says there are a few things to watch for before swimming and working.

steps.text: 聽營養師的島嶼飲食課
steps.textEn: Listen to the dietitian's island food class

lines.zh: 芋頭和地瓜給力氣，魚給蛋白質，海菜和野菜給礦物質。
lines.en: Taro and sweet potato give energy, fish gives protein, seaweed and wild greens give minerals.

lines.zh: 島上傳統的餐桌，本來就很均衡。
lines.en: The island's traditional table was already well balanced.

toastEn: You learned about the nutrition of island food.

hint.zh: 衛生所的營養師在講島上的食物。
hint.en: The health station dietitian is talking about island food.

name.zh: 和營養師比較傳統食物與進口食物（食物主權）
name.en: Compare traditional and imported food with the dietitian (food sovereignty)

text.coop: 雙人：族女＋旅人，在衛生所
text.coopEn: Pair: Tao woman + Traveller, at the health station
text.unlock: 食物主權卡、糧倉說明加註
text.unlockEn: Food sovereignty card, note added to the food store

steps.text: 族女和旅人一起，和營養師比較傳統食物與進口食物
steps.textEn: The Tao woman and the traveller compare traditional and imported food with the dietitian

lines.zh: 家裡的芋頭、飛魚、地瓜，都是自己種、自己捕的。
lines.en: The taro, flying fish and sweet potato at home — we grow and catch them all ourselves.

lines.zh: 進口的麵和罐頭很方便，可是船一停就沒有了。
lines.en: Imported noodles and cans are handy, but when the boat stops, they're gone.

lines.zh: 自己種的、自己捕的，是島上的人自己能決定的食物。這就叫食物主權。
lines.en: Food you grow and catch yourselves is food the island's people can decide on for themselves. That's called food sovereignty.

lines.zh: 原來吃什麼，也是一種可以自己決定的事。
lines.en: So what we eat is something we can decide for ourselves too.

toast: 糧倉說明加上「自己能決定的食物」。
toastEn: The food store note now adds "food we can decide on ourselves".

hint.zh: 採過芋頭之後，族女可以帶旅人去和營養師聊聊傳統食物。
hint.en: After picking taro, the Tao woman can take the traveller to talk with the dietitian about traditional food.

review: 食物主權的說法請族人確認
